boundary_and_continuum_factorial.lines: Unmodified isolated escape-probability lines, not the49 resolved groups.
boundary_and_continuum_factorial.continuum_grid: Same718-node frequency grid in all four cases; continuum order2.
boundary_and_continuum_factorial.denominator: The same legacy-zero-boundary gross thermal_scale per cell for all four contrasts; never the near-zero net heating.
boundary_and_continuum_factorial.continuum_contrast: All four cases are valid fixed-state evaluations with isolated EP lines. Continuum contrast includes slab versus finite sphere, attenuation versus coherent Thomson reservoir, and angle2 versus chord64. Tail is endpoint-matched 10000K photosphere. No root, observer or thermal adequacy inference.
boundary_and_continuum_factorial.tail_definition: Endpoint-continuous Planck shape,10000K,1e9Hz to originalPHXanchor,4097logpoints;8193point boundaryprojection control. Original table retained aboveanchor. No stellar absorption lines added.
boundary_and_continuum_factorial.interpretation: One local SE target at supplied populations/T/nH. Each reconstructed field is causal to the changed operator or boundary, but neither is a complete population/thermal/wind root. The closure contrast includes geometry, scattering and angles, not geometry alone.

reciprocal_metal_groups.design: Same H+Fe grid/metadata in continuum-only,H-only,Fe-only,both controls. Remove opacity and emission together. Rates for absent components are passive diagnostics, never an implemented one-way pump.
reciprocal_metal_groups.difference: Fe-only formal versus combined formal isolates overlap; replacing the original isolated Fe escape closure is a separate change.
reciprocal_metal_groups.interpretation: The selected Fe excitation changes are real conditional operator responses. They are not population, thermal or global derivative error bounds; this does not test the later Solar API integration.

later_API_integration.scope: Synthetic FeII200/H14->7 composition integration; not thermal root or reference agreement.

A thick synthetic-column test exercises nonzero OTS removal.

retained_setup_failure.stage: Constructing shared-sphere model after both legacy controls passed bitwise output parity.
retained_setup_failure.cause: Equivalent dimensional expressions c/(3e-4) and c/(3.*1e-4) differ by one float64 ULP. Passing both as distinct edges creates duplicate rounded Gauss nodes; the existing increasing-frequency guard rejects construction.
retained_setup_failure.physical_result: No shared-geometry evaluation occurred; valid completed legacy results are retained.
retained_setup_failure.resolution: Use the same canonical c/(3.*1e-4) expression in both branches. Keep the old source/driver/output unchanged; rerun new explicitly labeled canonical-input experiment.
